title: Global Semiconductor Chips Shortage Analysis Report 2021
主要内容: The global semiconductor chips market is projected to grow from $381.0 billion in 2021 to $553.6 billion by 2026, with a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 7.8%. The Americas market is expected to grow from $82.8 billion to $122.6 billion at a CAGR of 8.2%, while the Asia-Pacific market is projected to rise from $266.8 billion to $392.3 billion at a CAGR of 8.0%. The report highlights the global semiconductor chip shortage of 2021, driven by increased adoption of IoT, AI, 5G, and automotive sectors. Key restraints include global political, economic, and financial crises, as well as a lack of trained individuals in memory chips. The shortage is attributed to sudden demand for consumer electronics, supply chain disruptions, trade wars, and drought in Taiwan. The market is segmented by type (memory, logic, microprocessors, microcontrollers, analog chips) and end users (computing, automotive, consumer electronics, industrial wireless communication). Major companies profiled include Advanced Micro Devices Inc., Apple Inc., Broadcom Inc., Infineon Technologies Ag, Intel Corp., Kioxia Holdings Corp., Mediatek Inc., Micron Technology Inc., Nvidia Corp., Qualcomm Inc., and Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd.
